title: Static elastic analysis.
officialText: For analysis of this type, dynamic effects of member loss or dynamic effects of specific local loads need not be considered. The structural demand is obtained from linear static analysis. However, structural member capacity is based on ultimate capacity of the entire cross section. The demand/capacity ratio of structural elements shall not exceed one.
